items.title_orig: Is it just me or has the love of Alice in Chains exploded in the last year or two online? I don't remember being as prominently featured in places like Reddit before.
items.article_text:
Maybe it's just the algorithm, but it seems like there's been a surge of interest in Alice in Chains in the last couple of years. 
 I was around in the peak grunge era and people liked them, to be sure, but once Layne passed they kind of faded out of the conversation - or so it seemed to me. The grunge-era bands people talked about consistently were Pearl Jam, Soundgarden, Nirvana, Stone Temple Pilots, etc.
 I don't have a strong opinion on the band but the seeming resurgence in popularity seems striking. 
 So has it always been this way and I just didn't notice, is the algorithm picking up on some video I watched 2 years ago, or is this all some dark conspiracy?
